# FG-REVIEW-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `two_merges_of_one_merge_request_at_once_let_exactly_one_win` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストはマージを実行中です。終わるまで待ってから確認してください。
- en: This merge request is being merged. Wait for it to finish, then check again.
- id: Merge request ini sedang digabungkan. Tunggu hingga selesai, lalu periksa lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A second merge, a close, a retarget or a draft toggle reached a merge request that has a merge attempt in progress (`queued`, `prepared` or `executing` in forge.merge_request_merges; ADR-0024 §4.2). At most one attempt per merge request is live (checked under the merge request's row lock; the partial unique index merge_request_merges_one_live is the backstop). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `merge_request_id`, `merge_id` (the live attempt), `state` and `action`. `gstn mr merge-status --project ID --iid N` shows the attempt; an attempt that stays `executing` is runbook merge-execution.

## 対処 (fix)

Wait for the merge to finish (`gstn mr merge-status --wait`); if it was superseded, merge again.
